extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: classic double-decker bus (London style), approx. 8.6 x 2.5 x 4.3 m (L x W x H), wheel diameter 1.0 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; open rear boarding platform on the left-hand side with grab pole and a visible staircase to the upper deck (simple platform interior); 4 wheels (rear with dual tires) are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll); neutral glowing destination display without text or route number; opaque tinted windows, no saloon interior; no brand, no text, no registration

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
